run_GTestListTestsOutputUnitTest_testXml: run the testXml method to verify XML output for listing tests in a Google Test binary
run_GTestListTestsOutputUnitTest_testJSO: run the testJSON method to verify JSON output for listing tests in a Google Test binary
test_GTestListTestsOutputUnitTest__GetOu: test the _GetOutput method to invoke a gtest binary with --gtest_list_tests and read its output file
test_GTestListTestsOutputUnitTest__TestO: test the _TestOutput method to compare actual output against expected regex patterns line by line
run_gtest_list_tests_flag: run the gtest_list_output_unittest_ binary with --gtest_list_tests and --gtest_output flags to list tests as XML or JSON
